testChange.reason: Three pre-existing tests encoded the pre-fold layout and were updated to the moved contract, none weakened: WorktreeView.test.ts mount() now passes getInitialIdleSeeded so tests about OTHER contracts see the tail already presented (and therefore open) rather than each fighting a fold they are not about; WorktreeController.test.ts counted rendered rows for "renders the pushed tree" and now counts drawn rows PLUS the disclosure count, which is the reachability the spec actually requires; WorktreeController.state.test.ts asserted worktreeCollapsed was empty and now asserts that of worktree keys only, plus that the namespaced idle-tail key IS seeded — the namespace exists precisely so those two claims are separable.

testChange.reason: Round-1 fixes. Two assertions the review found VACUOUS were replaced, not relaxed: WorktreeController.test.ts pinned drawn+hidden, which also held for 6+0 and survived deleting the fold outright, and now pins both numbers; the "no presence block" clause asserted on .wt-glyph .wt-state, undefined for any agentless worktree with or without the idle treatment, and now asserts on .wt-presence scoped to the sibling. Two cap assertions moved with the W4 label fix (the affordance now reports what the cap excluded, per the requirement it did not meet), and the cap-and-fold fixture was changed from 8 to 10 agentless so the two affordances report DIFFERENT numbers — at 4 and 4 the assertions could not tell which described which. Three new regression tests added for B1/B2/W1.
